@font-face{font-family:"DaragatPrintKurdish";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-style:normal;font-weight:500 900;font-display:block}
html{direction:rtl;text-rendering:auto}
/* Do not override icon font families or title/teacher-generated layouts on screen. */
body,button,input,textarea,select,option{word-break:normal}
@media(max-width:767px){html,body{max-width:100%}button,input,select,textarea{max-width:100%}input,textarea,select{font-size:16px}button{white-space:normal}}
@media print{
 @page{margin:9mm}
 html,body{direction:rtl!important;background:#fff!important;color:#111!important;overflow:visible!important}
 body,body button,body input,body textarea,body select,body table,body th,body td,body p,body li,body h1,body h2,body h3,body h4,body div,body span,body label{font-family:var(--daragat-print-font)!important;font-kerning:normal;letter-spacing:normal;word-break:normal}
 .fa,.fas,.far,.fab,.fa-solid,.fa-regular,.fa-brands,[class^="fa-"],[class*=" fa-"]{font-family:"Font Awesome 6 Free"!important}
 .fab,.fa-brands{font-family:"Font Awesome 6 Brands"!important}
 tr,td,th,thead,.card{break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
 thead{display:table-header-group}tfoot{display:table-footer-group}
}

html[lang],body{direction:rtl} #ys-intro-shell, #ys-intro-shell *{box-sizing:border-box} @media print{#ys-intro-shell,.ys-contact-link{display:none!important}}
</style>
